# AZ-700 Practice Section 1

[![Open in Quiz Player](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_in-Quiz_Player-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://quizplay.io/quiz.html?source=quizplay-io/quiz-player-quizzes-az-700-question-set-1)

![Preview](assets/images/preview_az700.svg)

Practice questions for the **Microsoft Azure Networking (AZ-700)** certification exam. This set tests your understanding of designing and implementing core networking infrastructure, hybrid connectivity, application delivery services, private access to Azure services, and network security — the five core skill areas of the exam.

## Content Overview

- **36 Questions** (12 case-study + 24 standalone) — Single choice, multiple choice, ordering, and matching
- **Topics**:
  - Design and Implement Core Networking Infrastructure (10 questions)
  - Design, Implement, and Manage Connectivity Services (8 questions)
  - Design and Implement Application Delivery Services (7 questions)
  - Design and Implement Private Access to Azure Services (5 questions)
  - Design and Implement Azure Network Security Services (6 questions)

## What This Does Not Cover

This question set focuses on **scenario-based conceptual understanding**. It does not cover hands-on lab exercises, CLI/PowerShell command syntax drills, or pricing calculator questions. It is not a substitute for official Microsoft Learn training paths.

## Disclaimer

> [!IMPORTANT]
> These questions are **AI-generated** for study and practice purposes. They are **not** exam dumps and do not contain actual questions from the Microsoft certification exam. Use them to test your understanding of Azure networking concepts, not as a substitute for official study materials.

## Usage

This repository is designed to be used with the [Quiz Player](https://quizplay.io). Click the badge above to launch the quiz directly.
